messages:
Ravi Menon: Heads-up team 14CB
We need a tight EBR for Crestline next week. Core asks: 1) one-slide account health snapshot; 2) top 3 risks + proposed mitigations; 3) enablement asks and timing; 4) exec bullets (2min). Can owners volunteer? Deck link: https://redwood.example/ebrs/crestline. Please follow the slide numbering in the template.

Alisha Gomez: I can take the health snapshot (slide 2). Will pull activation/cohort metrics and a short trend line. ETA Mon EOD.

Drew Baker: I'll do risks & mitigation (slide 5). Quick note: onboarding is lagging because of schema onboarding failures. I need the failure log counts and backlog number. @Nora can you share backlog?

Nora Park: Backlog snapshot below:

```
open_onboarding_tickets: 38
avg_ticket_age_days: 12
schema_failure_rate_week: 4.1%
workaround_adoption: 21%
```

Nora Park: We also got customer feedback asking for a 'how-to' workshop. Could be an enablement ask.

Alisha Gomez: Good catch. I'll add a one-line NPS quote and a tiny trend chart. Also, can someone verify renewal signal level? I have account spend cadence but not NRR projection.

Ravi Menon: Finance shared a quick projection: projected NRR 0.96 but with current churn signals could slide to 0.92. Mark as 'elevated risk' unless we show remediation traction.

Drew Baker: I'll propose a 6-week remediation timeline and owners for each step (ops, product, enablement). Slide 6 will be owners + dates.

Nora Park: Enablement ask: 60-minute technical workshop + follow-up office hours. I can host but need marketing to prepare a short 'how-to' doc.

Alisha Gomez: I'll add that to enablement slide and include proposed dates (next Tue/Thu).

Ravi Menon: Exec bullets: I'll draft two lines: 1) "Action underway to address onboarding schema failures with triage plan and SR#1129"; 2) "Propose a 3-month Optimize consult as a remediation credit to accelerate activation". Will circulate in draft by Tue morning.

EBR Reminders Bot: Reminder: Deck must be uploaded to /share/ebrs/crestline by Wed 17:00 to be included in exec packet.

Drew Baker: Quick ask to legal/compliance: is the 3-month consult okay as a one-off concession? @Alisha can you confirm Legal OK?

Alisha Gomez: I pinged Legal earlier; they replied OK with standard attachment. I'll paste legal thread link in the deck notes.

Nora Park: I'll add the workshop invite once dates confirmed. Also adding a brief customer success playbook snippet for the appendix.

Ravi Menon: Plan: owners assemble slides by Tue EOD, internal review Wed 10:00, dry run Thu 08:30. If slides not in by Tue EOD, we'll escalate to the ops pod. Please flag blockers here.

Drew Baker: Understood. I'll put my slide in by Mon EOD and include the SR and timeline.

Alisha Gomez: Copy 4E5 I'll push metrics and chart tonight and tag reviewers.

Nora Park: Adding backlog cleanup action: ops x2 days/week until cleared; owners: Nora + Drew.

Ravi Menon: Thanks all. Small ask: keep each slide to 3 bullets max for exec clarity. :white_check_mark:

Drew Baker: Noted.
